subject: Taxes
title: Lebanon's WhatsApp Tax
description: Learn Lebanon's WhatsApp Tax in one minute.

hook.text: In October 2019, Lebanon announced a $6/month tax on WhatsApp calls.

buildup.text: Lebanon's WhatsApp Tax sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: The tax was canceled within hours, but protests continued.

twist.text: The prime minister resigned within two weeks. A $6 tax toppled a government because trust was already zero.

climax.text: Lebanon showed that when citizens distrust their government, even a trivial tax sparks systemic revolt.

punchline.text: A $6 tax on WhatsApp. A prime minister gone in two weeks.

quiz.question: What happened after Lebanon proposed the WhatsApp tax?
options: Mass protests led to the PM's resignation
